# Portable acceptance fixtures

`legacy-producer.tar.gz` is a synthetic-identity archive produced by the real
`validator-backup.sh create gdc-node1` producer at runbook revision
`abf9bcf51bfdcaa133a1dc8f14b3bf5fb55c016f`. Its producer ran against a
network-isolated local SSH transport and self-verified the archive before
publication. It is not a live-network recovery claim.

`canonical-jq-golden.json` is generated by the independent jq transformation
from `canonical-input.json`. The signing and join-recovery corpora are
synthetic portable input cases, not historical producer material.
